structured.approach: I followed the frontend-steps skill for FE-02 and got a receipt for my one readable contracted input, feat.tasks (revision b0fd4d2), through context_get. org.permission_table is restricted and passed by reference only, so I took the grant for ap_portal from the step's repo-access tool view, which summarises the permission table. From feat.tasks I worked out what the Frontend task TSK-07 needs: a pure HTML-rendering function in ap_portal, files in budget limited to index.js, package.json and the portal test file, no new technology, no transport layer and no LLM. So it needs no secret. I also looked through the ap_portal checkout for credential or environment-variable reads and found nothing beyond NODE_PATH in the CI script. I don't cite that check, so the claims rest only on receipted sources. The step blocked shell commands, so I used file tools only. Need and grant agree: none and none. So I raised no access request and wrote task.secrets_scope with names only.

claims.text: The permission table grants no secrets for the ap_portal repository, and none are required for it.
The Frontend task TSK-07 builds an exported renderOverdueRisk(rows) that returns an HTML table string with class overdue-risk, or an empty string for missing, null or empty rows.
The TSK-07 files in budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js, so no configuration or credential file is in scope.
The tasks add no new technology: only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS.
CT-1 has no transport layer (adding one would re-trigger DES-01), and TSK-07 depends only on the CT-1 field list, so the portal task calls no service.
The CI bar for TSK-07 is compile, unit tests, coverage of at least 90% and static checks, run with node:test and NODE_PATH=src. None of these needs a secret.
No access request is needed for FE-02, because the needed and granted secret sets are both empty.
The input feat.tasks was read at revision b0fd4d2, produced by DES-04; org.permission_table is restricted and passed by reference only.

structured.summary: I wrote task.secrets_scope for TSK-07 in ap_portal. No secrets are required and none are granted (permission table via tool:repo-access), so I raised no access request. The task is a pure Node.js rendering change with no transport, service or LLM call. Local and CI runs need no credentials. A guardrail is carried to FE-04: add no secret or environment-variable read for TSK-07. There are no open questions.
